snippets.snippet_text: "Etsy.com recorded 459.5 million total visits in January 2026. Engagement remained solid, with a 39.63% bounce rate, 6.11 pages per visit, and an average session length of 00:04:45. Traffic fell by 12.32% versus the prior month (month-over-month). In rankings, Etsy.com stood at Global Rank #64, U.S. Rank #30, and Category Rank #5"
